auditor_identity: same-context session agent (run executor), acting as the oracle auditor; shown ONLY world_id, surface_text, gold_label per world (no class field, no S*, no machine fields)
independence_caveat: This is a same-context oracle audit, NOT independent human review. It satisfies the receipt's mechanical constraints (no arm outputs existed at audit time) and checks rendering/label integrity, but auditor and generator author share a context. Independent re-audit is a registered residual for any governance continuation.
method: Each of the 40 seed-sampled worlds was read in full; the auditor judged solvability implied by the rendered world description alone (a fully licensed chain across buried sources, or an admissible detour avoiding a declared obstruction cover, implies SOLVABLE; a goal with no incoming edge anywhere in the full fact set, or a chain whose only route contains an edge licensed below demand, implies UNSOLVABLE; budget class and distractor pressure affect arms, never world solvability) and compared it to gold.
per_world_verdicts: all 40 AGREE; no world required interpretation beyond the rendered text (sampled: 38 SOLVABLE — licensed chains or admissible detours; 2 UNSOLVABLE — both goal-disconnected N7 rows)
